# main=true written in an output block emits func main() into the package the
# block names, for a program that calls it from a main of its own. Only a build
# that becomes a binary (`sngl run`, `sngl build`) is package main -- see
# testdata/generate_go_main_package.txtar.

sngl generate --platform=fyne --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
grep '^package widgets$' out/model.go
grep '^func main\(\)' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"

output {
    go {
        fyne(package="widgets", main=true)
    }
}

ui.window #app(title="Hi") {
    ui.text(value="hi")
}
